title: Build a Complete HTML Document Skeleton
task: Create a standard HTML document structure. Include the `<!DOCTYPE html>` declaration, the root `<html>` element, a `<head>` section containing a `<title>` with text, and a visible `<body>` containing an `<h1>` heading.
hints: Start your file with `<!DOCTYPE html>` and wrap everything inside `<html lang="en">`.
Inside `<head>`, add a `<title>` tag with a descriptive title for your page.
Add a `<body>` element right after `<head>` and put your `<h1>` heading inside it.

rules.message: Document must contain an <html> root element.
A <title> element must be placed inside <head>.
An <h1> heading must be placed inside <body>.
